title: Once your understanding deepens, numbers are merely the result
author: MarilynLongan
selftext:
I used to always look for shortcuts

Later, I realized

that making money depends on luck,

but consistently making money depends on understanding

Today, as I watched my account balance fluctuate,

the biggest takeaway wasn’t the numbers themselves,

but the fact that I finally understood:

execution, foresight,

discipline, and emotional control

The market rewards those with a long term perspective

The rest is up to time

This is merely a record of my personal learning journey and does not constitute any investment advice
